Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Summer Wellness with Vitamins & Electrolytes Package?
Ans.
This specially curated summer health package by Thyrocare includes 107 parameters to evaluate essential vitamins, minerals, and electrolytes required for optimal hydration and energy during hot weather. The profile consists of Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, along with comprehensive health assessments such as Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Lipid Profile, Thyroid Profile, Diabetes markers. These tests are conducted using Thyrocare’s fully automated and NABL/ISO-certified diagnostic systems to ensure accurate and reliable results.
Q. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Summer Wellness with Vitamins & Electrolytes test?
Ans.
This package is ideal for individuals who experience symptoms related to dehydration, fatigue, low immunity, muscle cramps, or poor energy levels during the summer months. It is also suitable for those who are frequently exposed to high temperatures, have outdoor work schedules, or want to maintain optimal wellness during seasonal changes. The test helps assess deficiencies or imbalances that can worsen in summer and supports preventive care planning.
Q. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Summer Wellness test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting is required before the sample collection. A fasting period of 8 to 12 hours is recommended to ensure accurate readings for metabolic and vitamin-related markers, especially blood sugar, lipid profile, and insulin levels. During fasting, only plain water is permitted.
Q. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Summer Wellness test?
Ans.
Thyrocare provides free home sample collection services across India. A certified phlebotomist will visit your location at the scheduled time to collect the required blood and urine samples. The collected samples are transported securely to Thyrocare’s advanced, automated diagnostic laboratories that are accredited by NABL and ISO, ensuring precision and reliability at every step.
Q. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Summer Wellness with Vitamins & Electrolytes Package?
Ans.
The Thyrocare Summer Wellness package is priced at Rs 1,949 for one individual. There is also a value pack available for two people at Rs 2,998 . The pricing includes all 107 tests, home sample collection, and delivery of digital reports via SMS and email, offering exceptional value for preventive health screening.
Q. When will I receive my test report from Thyrocare?
Ans.
Test results are typically delivered within 24 to 48 hours after sample collection. Thyrocare ensures quick turnaround with digital reports shared directly to your registered mobile number and email ID. This allows you to access and share your health report conveniently and securely.
Q. Why choose Thyrocare for this summer health checkup?
Ans.
Thyrocare is a leading name in diagnostic services with over 25 years of experience and a strong presence across India. It is known for offering affordable health packages, home collection services, and high-precision results using fully automated laboratory infrastructure. The Summer Wellness with Vitamins & Electrolytes Package is designed specifically for seasonal health challenges, helping individuals stay energized, hydrated, and nutritionally balanced through expert screening and timely insights.
Q. Does this package include electrolyte tests like Sodium, Potassium, and Chloride?
Ans.
Yes, the Summer Wellness Package includes key electrolyte markers such as Sodium, Potassium, Chloride, and Calcium, which are crucial for maintaining fluid balance, preventing dehydration, and ensuring optimal muscle and nerve function during the hot weather.
Q. Can children or elderly people take this test?
Ans.
Yes, this test is suitable for all age groups, especially elderly individuals and children who may be more vulnerable to heat-related imbalances. It’s advisable to consult a healthcare provider before booking for children below 12 years.
